actual routes read before optional prediction submission; hot work and prediction overlap demanded reads
optional prediction-only FP16 input; true routing and expert math unchanged

correctness_before_speed.cpu: slot bounds/empty/overflow, literal control parsers, Kani actual functions with 0..20 symbolic slots, full i32 capacity/u32 IDs; parsers arbitrary bytes length<=5
correctness_before_speed.gpu: independent MoE/complete logits248320 and states16+held, MTP head and pair/session, real bridge budgets1/2/3/17/rejection/cancel/recovery, both predictor dtypes and LRU-only control
correctness_before_speed.mechanism: test-only host-readback counter; readiness query for GPU arrays; bounded CPU event timestamps. Deliberately slow test-only prediction must still be unfinished at first demanded read. Regression/mutation restores old early readback and must fail. No long GPU-delay kernel in throughput runs.
correctness_before_speed.checks: fmt, strict CPU/MLX-chat Clippy, CPU/release suites, shipped build, relevant Python suite/guard failures; Kani targeted120s then relevant suite, actual MLX path attempt120s. CBMC real bridge attempt120s; unsupported paths remain unverified.

screen.candidate: one final frozen binary, all four candidate arms
screen.parity: all128 IDs/hash/text equal archived H20 oracle; prefix64 and MTP counters exact
screen.selection: C0-LFU qualifies common-path gain if >=1% above faster R0 in both prompts. A LES arm qualifies only if >=1% above max(faster R0,C0-LFU,C0-LRU) in both prompts. Select eligible LES arm with highest geometric ratio, prefer f32 on tie. Screen is not gain confirmation.

confirmation.when: only eligible common-path and/or LES mode; no reruns for noise
confirmation.per_mode: two H-C/C-H paired blocks per MAIN/HOLD (8arms), one128warm and three128measured per arm
confirmation.criteria: all four paired gains>=1%, range<=3percentagepoints per prompt, same power/parity/memory limits. Stop conservatively if required condition becomes impossible.
confirmation.publication: push to PR34 once a gain is actually confirmed; identify runtime flags and mode. No merge/release/install.

source_freeze: runtime hashes, binaries and exact command/env matrices before first physical run; no compiler/prover/other GPU model during GPU measurements
